turns.text: Let's kick off the quarterly roadmap review. Our top priority for next quarter is improving search latency across the platform.
Agreed. Support tickets about slow search results have gone up almost thirty percent since the last release.
Right, and the engineering team already proposed adding a caching layer in front of the database to cut down repeated queries.
Caching should help a lot, but we also need to prioritize the mobile app redesign that customers have been asking about for months.
That's fair. Let's timebox the redesign to six weeks and make sure it doesn't block the search latency work.
Sounds workable. What about the analytics dashboard the sales team requested last quarter?
I'd like to push that to the following quarter unless someone has a strong argument for doing it sooner.
Sales has been vocal about it, but I think search performance and the mobile redesign are more urgent for retention.
Agreed, retention is the metric leadership cares about most this cycle.
Let's also talk about technical debt. The billing service is still running on the old framework version.
Yes, we should allocate at least one engineer for two weeks to migrate billing off the deprecated framework before it loses support.
Makes sense, security has flagged that as a risk a couple of times already.
One more item, the product roadmap review from marketing wants a public changelog page so customers can see what shipped each week.
I like that idea. It's low effort and it directly addresses customer complaints about not knowing what changed between releases.
I'll draft a one page proposal for the changelog page and share it by Friday.
Great. To summarize, our priorities are search latency improvements, the mobile redesign, the billing framework migration, and the changelog page.
The analytics dashboard and anything else not mentioned gets pushed to next quarter unless something urgent comes up.
Perfect, let's get this roadmap into the planning doc and share it with the wider team tomorrow morning.
